population: Exact fresh three-pair/six-unit P07 schedule, seeds260926023–260926025; all retained attempts; no additions/retries or historical pooling

generation_precondition.physical_gate_failures: Retain and plot every physical negative; no exclusion based on favorable physical results
generation_precondition.matrix_incomplete_action: MarkPHY05 not_complete; no representative replacement/fabricated missing points/result plot without six independent complete measurement audits.

representative_rule.sort_statistic: Each of the three control-arm maximum absolute center-steering change rates derived independently from world-link relative quaternions on the original 20 ms source grid
sort_order: ascending integer seed for exact ties
representative_rule.selection: middle (index 1) control in sorted list; its paired treatment is the sole representative timeline
representative_rule.selection_timing: Only after complete independent audit of all six consumed units; no treatment outcome enters selection
representative_rule.peak_window_rule: Full formal 36-second timeline shown for selected pair; any local zoom must use the control maximum absolute 20 ms interval midpoint ±0.25 seconds for both arms, clipped at formal endpoints, without selecting treatment peak

measurement_definition.actual_steering_source: /astra/world_links raw links, WorldUpdateEnd; use robot base_link-relative front_left/right_steer_link quaternions, not joint_states timestamps or target phase
measurement_definition.left_right_to_center: k_left=tan(left)/(L+track/2*tan(left)); k_right=tan(right)/(L-track/2*tan(right)); center=atan(L*(k_left+k_right)/2), with L/track from each frozen effective contract
measurement_definition.formal_window: Exactly the frozen P07 assessor integer window schedule_start_ns <= row.ns <= schedule_start_ns + round(total_schedule_s*1e9); validate source ns/t agreement. No floating-point endpoint selection.
measurement_definition.derivative: Adjacent unsmoothed actual center values divided by their own source timestamp difference, using the unchanged frozen derivative formula and original 20 ms world-link source grid; midpoint labels based on the same two source timestamps.
measurement_definition.x_axis: Actual world-link source ns minus schedule_start_ns, in seconds; do not shift the curve onto joint or target publication phase
measurement_definition.targets: If shown, retain their own source stamps and label reference versus actual explicitly
measurement_definition.trajectory: Actual world model/base poses on their own source time grid; no planned/reference trajectory presented as execution
measurement_definition.steady_steering_error: For every frozen phase use exactly its final 0.75-second half-open integer tail [phase_end_ns−750000000, phase_end_ns). Compare measured world-link actual center with requested/clipped center. No favorable subinterval selection.
measurement_definition.threshold: Frozen effective maxSteeringRate plus actual_center_slew_tolerance_radps, read from contract; do not retune from observations
measurement_definition.qualification_roster: Final P07 has122 checks. Preserve all original gate outcomes, including physical negatives; old headerless relay diagnostic is not a qualification check.

panels.all_pairs: Show all three paired control/treatment actual 20 ms peak points connected by seed; report raw numeric values and original gate outcomes for all six
panels.steady_state: Show all six measured phase-tail steering errors and original fixed gate, preserving phase labels
panels.representative: Only the predeclared median-control pair; full actual steering/source-target timeline and actual XY trajectory. Plot every native measured point; visibly disclose the selection rule.
panels.dense_2ms: May be tabulated as a separately labelled supplementary diagnostic, never used to replace the 20 ms selection statistic or qualification gate
panels.command_ingress: Optional separate diagnostic source timeline: command-event time and actual driver receipt time retain their distinct source stamps; no inference of physical force application from acceptance.

claims: Actuator qualification and measurement diagnosis only; no navigation performance, general safety, real vehicle, or broad statistical superiority claim from three simulator seed pairs

rendering.height: Choose once after layout, then retain revisions; enough room for legible labels and gate lines
required: actual view_image on native PNG and 170 mm PDF raster
preserve failed visual revisions and repair history
